svg.aria-label: Architecture — structural view (4 layers). Access + authentication: User / browser, API Gateway (REST), Amazon Cognito. Security + compliance controls: Security Hub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail audit. Compute + AI processing: ECS/Fargate (HA), Bedrock + Claude, OpenSearch nodes. Storage + observability: S3 + data pipeline, MLFlow tracking, Grafana + Arize
